Heard on I.A.No.27778 of 2023 application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Neelesh Prajapati @ Suraj arising out of judgment dated 04.10.2023 delivered in S.T No.42/2021 passed by Second Additional Sessions Judge, Annuppur District Annuppur.

entities.text: Second Additional Sessions Judge, Annuppur District Annuppur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant has been convicted under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I for 20 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that prosecutrix was major and was aged about 19 years.
The appellant and victim developed physical relation on their own volition.

By placing reliance in the case of Dr. Dhruvaram Murlidhar Sonar Vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in AIR 2019 SC 327, it is submitted that necessary ingredients for attracting 'rape' are not present in the instant case.

entities.text: Dr. Dhruvaram Murlidhar Sonar Vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in AIR 2019 SC 327
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The appellant is in custody since 04.10.2023.
There is no possibility of early hearing of this appeal in near future.
Moreso, as per prosecution story, the last physical relation between the appellant and victim had taken place on 06.12.2020, whereas the FIR was lodged on 16.09.2021.
It is clearly an after thought on the part of prosecutrix.
Thus , remaining jail sentence of the present appellant may be suspended.
The prayer is opposed by learned Government Counsel on the basis of objection

Considering the aforesaid factual backdrop and bleak chances of final hearing in near future, without expressing any conclusive opinion on the merits of the case, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 27778 of 2023 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited), the remaining jail sentence of this appellant is hereby suspended and it is directed that appellant - Neelesh Prajapati @ Suraj be Neelesh Prajapati@ Suraj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66784416/
1 released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the trial Court, Annuppur District Annuppur on 29.04.2024 and also on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
